assessment_scope: Independent adversarial challenge of all seven semantic cases and the final publication-marker reconciliation, skill install guidance, taxonomy/vocabulary, scaffold, Decision 0053 alignment and release checklist.
conclusion: All seven cases stand. The compatibility release_state accurately describes the source snapshot, while external publication requires the immutable GitHub Release and matching tag target. V3.0.0 is recorded as published but does not meet immutable installation gate; v3.0.1 / skill 2.0.1 remains an unreleased target pending human review, merge and manual immutable publication. No real vault or host runtime was exercised.

case_challenges.rationale: The V3 skill preserves the separate V2 migration gate and never treats publication as approval to write migrated content.
Explicit actor and authorized_vault_ids coverage remain required before governed reads; login or repository access does not substitute.
Entity, vault, source and scope boundaries remain distinct; shared provider access does not authorize cross-entity reads.
Unknown, stale or conflicting source state remains explicit and does not become truth through retrieval or hashes.
The skill retains raw V3.0.0 as its baseline; the patch changes only publication markers and installation guidance.
Package integrity, compatibility, semantic review, human approval, authorization and host capability remain separate gates.

Installation resolves the manifest-selected release tag, requires GitHub immutable:true and tag-target match, pins the commit, checks hashes, and keeps the source-snapshot release_state distinct from external publication proof. The scaffold uses main only for availability metadata.

limits: No real-vault content was read or changed.
No Claude, Copilot or other host runtime was tested.
The v3.0.1 tag and GitHub Release are not created.
